name: Extra Field Configuration Examples
description: Provides example field plugins for Extra Field Configuration.
project_description: Submodule of extra_field_configuration providing two ready-to-use sample @ExtraFieldDisplay plugins that opt into the Extra Field Configuration deriver, so they appear as selectable providers on /admin/structure/extra-field. ExampleField (id 'example_configurable_field') extends ExtraFieldDisplayBase and returns a static #markup string from view(). ExampleFormattedField (id 'example_configurable_formatted_field') extends ExtraFieldDisplayFormattedBase, returns static #markup from viewElements() and supplies getLabel()/getLabelDisplay() so it renders with a field label. Both are pure demonstration code: static translated output, no user/remote input, no routes, permissions, config, services, or hooks of their own.
